name: ClinuxFlowProvenance
title: ClinuxFlow Provenance
description: Digital provenance for every write a ClinuxFlow workspace makes (a captured record, a registry journey's outcome): who made it, on whose behalf, from what, and when. Built and kept on the clinic's device (clinux-frontend src/provenance/), published to clinuxflow-api on the paid plan only. The ABDM IG (ndhm.in 6.5.0) profiles no Provenance, so this constrains base R4 directly. agent.who is the verified professional (HPR ID, https://doctor.ndhm.gov.in) once known, else the ClinuxFlow account; agent.onBehalfOf is the facility (HFR id, https://facility.ndhm.gov.in, once registered, else the clinic).

element.comment: The written record: a QuestionnaireResponse reference, or a logical reference by identifier (e.g. an HPR ID) before a local resource id exists.
Narrowed from 0..1: every ClinuxFlow write says what it was (v3-DataOperation CREATE / UPDATE / DELETE).
The verified professional (HPR ID) once linked, else the ClinuxFlow account.
Narrowed from 0..1: authority comes from the facility — its HFR id once registered, else the clinic. This is what ties a write to the role and entitlement it was made under.
